text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Finally, the spring Tenno Sho is here! I can't wait to see Sky and Spe face off!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I betcha Special Week'll win. She's improved so much recently!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Spe's stronger for sure, but Sky will definitely give her a run for her money at this length. Besides…

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: She always manages to pull through. I can just feel it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah. Have you seen Spe? She's gotten way better.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm trying to calm myself down the best I can. If breathing deeply will raise my chances of winning, even a little, then that's what I gotta do.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I know that alone won't cut it though. I have to give this everything I have, right?
choice_data_list: You can do it. And I'll be watching you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that sounds a little weird.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Don't make me all embarrassed. Just check in on me every once in a while, yeah?
